_comment: Tier-2 for febio::plasticity#0. H/E swept over three decades on the shipped uniaxial deck: every value runs to normal termination with exit 0 and no diagnostic, and the peak |sz| rises monotonically with H by more than a factor of two from the lowest ratio to the highest. That monotone rise is what makes "a peak stress well above Y is the correct answer, not a missed yield" checkable. The fixture computes the peaks; no number is carried in the catalogue text. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
